messages:
acme_ops: Heads up — after the role-tree merge this morning multiple users report 403 on the console and model endpoints. Console returns 403, model API returns `permission_denied`.
aya-support: Sorry, can you paste one console request id + user id so we can trace?
acme_ops: Request: req_0b7c9d8f, user: u_jonas. Console error: `permission_denied: resource=models.list`. Billing page also 403 for some users.
morgan: Copy — pulling RBAC audit logs. Did the merge include role-squash or an attribute backfill run?
acme_ops: It ran role-squash + attribute collapse as part of the rollout the SRE team requested. We only saw failures after the final commit.
samir: Looking at the post-merge audit: the role templates now reference attribute key "organization" but the backfill left many tenants using "org_id". That mismatch makes template evaluation false and removes grants like `model.viewer`.
irene: Confirmed. That rename would break mapping. Also seeing KMS decrypt failures for some tenants: `AccessDeniedException` on decrypt for tenant keys, preventing model artifact loads.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-3443 - Tenant access regression after role-tree migration (P1).
morgan: For KMS the logs show an alias mismatch: key alias used by service is `alias/redwood/acme`, key policy updated to `alias/redwood/acme-prod`. Decrypts fail when alias doesn't match binding. When decrypt fails the model load aborts and caller surfaces 403 downstream.
aya-support: So two concurrent issues: (1) attribute key rename causing missing role grants; (2) KMS alias/policy mismatch blocking decryption.
acme_ops: Do we have a safe short-term mitigation? Customers are blocked.
samir: Quick mitigation plan: (a) add transient role binding for affected orgs (grant `model.viewer`), (b) backfill attribute alias `org_id` -> map to `organization` in the resolver so templates evaluate, (c) run targeted backfill script for impacted tenants. I can push a backfill script: `./tools/backfill-attr --from org_id --to organization --org acme`.
irene: For KMS: we can add the old alias into the key policy (non-destructive) so decrypt succeeds while we standardize alias names. That requires sec-compliance approval to touch key policies; propose a short approval SMS and change window.
morgan: I'm applying the attribute aliasing change and adding transient role bindings for the top 10 affected users to unblock. Will test in staging then roll to prod.
aya-support: acme_ops — can you validate when you see the change?
acme_ops: Testing now — console loads and model list returns for u_jonas. Billing still 403 for u_claire.
samir: Claire's tenant missed the billing role mapping in the template. Adding `billing.viewer` mapping to the org group fixed it. Applying template fix cluster-wide now.
irene: KMS alias patch applied to the affected keys and validated: decrypt success on 6/6 sample tenants. No failures in artifact fetch logs.
morgan: Running an audit script to find tenants with `org_id` still present and queuing automated backfill for non-conflicting tenants.
acme_ops: Verified: u_jonas and u_claire can access console, models, and billing. All green from our side. Thanks.
oncall-bot: INC-2024-3443 status -> mitigated. Please file follow-up postmortem and add attribute-rename checks to the role-change checklist.
samir: Filing postmortem + remediation plan. Action items: 1) Add attribute alias support to role template resolver; 2) Add KMS alias-change runbook + approval gating; 3) Add invariant smoke tests that validate console/model/billing access for sample tenants after role changes; 4) Add KMS decrypt smoke in rollout tests.
irene: I'll add the KMS decrypt smoke and request the sec-compliance approval post-incident.
morgan: Closing thread after PRs land. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
